raw_segments.text: But as concerning justice, what is it?
To speak the truth and to pay your debts, no more than this.
And even to this are there not exceptions.
Suppose that a friend when in his right mind has deposited arms with me, and he asks for
them when he is not in his right mind, ought I to give them back to him?
No one would say that I ought or that I should be right in doing so, any more than they would
say that I ought always to speak the truth to one who is in his condition."
